transform: sum by (coa_iso, year) — coa_iso is the country where IDPs are located (host country = origin country for IDPs)
notes: idps field in the population endpoint is UNHCR-mandate IDP stock (end-year). Covers countries where UNHCR has an operational mandate; does NOT include IDMC global estimates (separate /idmc/ endpoint). Field is returned as string — cast to float. Group by coa_iso (country where IDPs reside, which equals country of origin for internal displacement). Confirmed field present from live API probe.

transform: annual_change_rate — compute year-on-year % change after summing idps by (coa_iso, year); first year of series = NaN
notes: Derived from the same raw pull as UNHCR_IDP. Formula: (idps_t - idps_{t-1}) / idps_{t-1} * 100. Handle zero denominator by returning NaN. Positive = displacement accelerating; negative = crisis easing or people returning. Share the raw fetch cache with UNHCR_IDP to avoid duplicate API calls.

transform: sum by (coo_iso, year) — aggregates refugees from a given origin country across all asylum countries
notes: refugees field is end-year stock. Group by coo_iso (country of origin) to get the total number of refugees who fled from each country. Numeric field confirmed from live API probe. Shares the same endpoint/raw-cache as UNHCR_REF_COA and UNHCR_IDP — fetch once, extract multiple series.

transform: sum by (coa_iso, year) — aggregates refugees hosted in each asylum country across all origin countries
notes: Same endpoint and payload as UNHCR_REF_COO but grouped by coa_iso. Measures humanitarian hosting burden. Shares the raw fetch cache. The existing fetcher already implements UN-02 (refugees by coa_iso) — this is the canonical enrichment-track version of that series with the new code.

derivation: UNHCR_REF_COO + asylum_seekers_coo + UNHCR_IDP: sum(refugees, asylum_seekers, idps) by (coa_iso, year) from population endpoint
transform: sum(refugees + asylum_seekers + idps) by (coa_iso, year) — all three fields present in same population endpoint record
notes: All three component fields (refugees, asylum_seekers, idps) are present in the same population endpoint response. asylum_seekers here is the pending/stock end-year figure (people awaiting decisions, not annual flows). Cast all three from string to float before summing; treat '-' or blank as 0. This is a country-of-presence metric (coa_iso = country where the displaced people are). Note: for a pure country-of-origin total, use UNHCR_REF_COO + UNHCR_ASYAPP_NEW_COO separately; the note clarifies this is the hosting-side composite. Single raw fetch serves all population-endpoint codes.

stateless field is end-year stock of persons without nationality in the given country (coa_iso). Field confirmed present in live API response; returned as string '0' — cast to float. Shares raw fetch cache with all other population-endpoint series. The existing fetcher already implements UN-06 (stateless by coa_iso); this is the enrichment-track alias.

transform: sum by (coo_iso, year) — aggregates all new asylum claims filed from each origin country across all destination countries
notes: applied field = new (first-instance) asylum applications submitted during the year (flow, not stock). Confirmed from live API probe: items contain year, coo_iso, coa_iso, applied. Group by coo_iso to get origin-country push signal. Repeat and appeal applications may or may not be included depending on procedure_type — for a clean new-application series, optionally filter procedure_type='G' (Government) but summing all procedure types is the standard approach. Separate endpoint from population; fetch independently.

derivation: asylum-decisions endpoint: dec_recognized / dec_total * 100, summed by (coo_iso, year) before dividing
transform: sum(dec_recognized) / sum(dec_total) * 100 by (coo_iso, year) — aggregate numerator and denominator separately, then divide
notes: Fields confirmed from live API probe: dec_recognized, dec_other, dec_rejected, dec_closed, dec_total. Recognition rate = recognized / total_decided. Must sum dec_recognized and dec_total separately across all coa dyads for a given (coo_iso, year) BEFORE dividing — do NOT average per-row rates. Exclude rows where dec_total = 0 or '-'. Result is 0–100 scale. High recognition rate = sending country is internationally considered a source of persecution or conflict. Separate /asylum-decisions/ endpoint fetch.

derivation: population[asylum_seekers by coa_iso] / asylum-decisions[dec_total by coa_iso]: pending_stock_t / annual_decisions_t, grouped by country (coa_iso) and year
transform: sum(asylum_seekers by coa_iso, year) / sum(dec_total by coa_iso, year) — both sums per (coa_iso, year) before dividing; result = implied years to clear backlog
notes: Medium confidence because: (1) asylum_seekers in the population endpoint is the pending end-year stock (confirmed from documentation: 'end-year population figures include asylum-seekers'), (2) dec_total from /asylum-decisions/ is annual decisions issued in that year (flow), both at (coa_iso, year) grain. Requires two separate endpoint fetches joined on (coa_iso, year). Exclude rows where dec_total = 0 to avoid div/zero. Result > 1 means backlog growing faster than decisions; < 1 = clearing. This is a measure of the HOST country's institutional capacity, not the origin country's conditions. Country_field is coa_iso (country of asylum) making this an asylum-system-capacity indicator.

endpoint_or_dataset: https://api.unhcr.org/population/v1/population/ (refugees field by coo_iso) + World Bank SP.POP.TOTL for denominator
filter_params: population: yearFrom=1990&limit=10000&coo_all=true&coa_all=true; WB SP.POP.TOTL: standard WB API call per country
transform: sum(refugees by coo_iso, year) / WB_SP.POP.TOTL * 100 — UNHCR refugee stock from origin country divided by origin country total population
notes: Medium confidence because it joins two providers: UNHCR (numerator) and World Bank SP.POP.TOTL (denominator). If WB population is missing for a country-year, the ratio cannot be computed. The UNHCR data is the same raw pull as UNHCR_REF_COO (reuse cache). WB population is already in the existing indicator catalog (or fetched by the WB fetcher). Implementation note: fetch population denominator from WB API (https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/{iso}/indicator/SP.POP.TOTL?format=json) or reuse from baked WB series. Result in % — e.g., 10 = 10% of country's population has fled as refugees.

endpoint_or_dataset: https://api.unhcr.org/population/v1/population/ (idps field by coa_iso) + World Bank SP.POP.TOTL for denominator
filter_params: population: yearFrom=1990&limit=10000&coo_all=true&coa_all=true; WB SP.POP.TOTL: standard WB API call per country
notes: Medium confidence for same cross-provider join reason as UNHCR_REF_RATIO_POP. IDP numerator from UNHCR /population/ endpoint (UNHCR-mandate IDPs only, not IDMC global estimate). Denominator = WB SP.POP.TOTL for the same country (coa_iso = country where IDPs reside = origin country for internal displacement). Coverage gap: UNHCR IDP data is only available for countries under UNHCR mandate — many countries will have NaN. Consider supplementing with /idmc/ endpoint for full global coverage as a fallback (but the two series are not directly comparable). Reuse raw fetch from UNHCR_IDP.
